elements.text: Assessment of global and cross-divisional BI-Regulations by RMS Panel.......7

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) implements the requirements of 028-BIP-00001, Boehringer Ingelheim ( BI) Regulations. It describes the entire lifecycle for BI Regulations covering creation, review, approval revision, periodic review, retirement/obsolescence as well as printing.

items: - Document Owners and authors of BI Regulations e.g., MSOs
- Regulation Management System (RMS) Panel Members acting on behalf of the functions in their responsibility
- Members of Document Administration Units (Doc Controls) responsible for (e.g.) the administration of Global and/or (Cross)Divisional BI Regulations

elements.text: The SOP does not apply to Policies and Guidance. 
Policies are governed by Corporate Compliance Committee (CCC), and therefore, out of scope of this SOP.
For the administration of Guidance, Divisional processes need to be in place.

cells.text:

Authorised and set into effect by responsible BI Management Content relates to both regulatory (compliance) as well as essential business operations. For details, see 028-BIP-000 0 1 .
Describes the requirements, systems and standards for BI processes. Umbrella document in “WHAT” style describing the principles.
Describes BI internal end-to-end processes. Systematic document in “HOW” style enabling users to perform the described process correctly.

Describes details of regulatory relevant processes on the basis of an overarching / governing SOP. The governing SOP has to be referenced in the WI. WI(s) used in more than one country have to refer to a divisional, cross-divisional, regional or a Global SOP.

Associated Documents support the content of a specific BI Regulation. They 
Provide supplemental information and/or are forms or templates to execute the main BI Regulation

Must not contradict the requirements / process of the main BI Regulation

ADs should not contain additional roles & responsibilities to the main BI Regulation. If those are needed WIs should be considered

Need to be mentioned in the main BI Regulation or in the listing of currently valid ADs e.g. AD00

May be revised independently from the main BI Regulation

If new ADs should be added independent of the revision of the main BI Regulation, this has to be explicitly stated in the main BI regulation Templates for Associated Documents (ADs) are available in the e- DMS

The entire main part of the BI Regulation must be translated, ADs as required. The original and the translated BI Regulation must be related to each other in e-DMS.

elements.text: This SOP has to be followed for Global and Cross-Divisional BI Regulations and can be used also for Divisional ones. For additional details, each division may issue Work Instructions or Divisional SOPs. Existing divisional SOPs need to be assessed and adapted accordingly within 6 months after effective date of this SOP. Any corrections needed due to the new e-DMS processes must be corrected at the next revision or Periodic Review at latest.

elements.text: USAGE IN THE AREA OF SCOPE

For the use of SOPs in the areas of scope at different sites, it is sufficient that BI Regulations are distributed and assigned to Learning Plans. No further steps are needed unless required by local laws or regulations.
